attributes.name: downstream_user_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer qualifies as a REACH downstream user and has been notified of their obligations under REACH, including use conditions, exposure scenarios, and risk management measures.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this regulatory profile becomes binding and governs chemical product sales and documentation obligations for the customer.

attributes.name: ehs_certification_expiry
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the customer's EHS certification. Triggers re-validation workflow when approaching expiry to ensure continued compliance eligibility.

attributes.name: ehs_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Certification Number
attributes.description: Certificate number or registration identifier for the customer's EHS management system certification (e.g., ISO 14001 certificate number), used for audit trail and verification.
attributes.references: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, OSHA, Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: ehs_certification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Certification Status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer's EHS certification relevant to handling and using chemical products (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 45001, OSHA VPP). Determines eligibility for certain product categories.
attributes.references: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, OSHA, Intelex EHS Management, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: end_use_declaration
attributes.description: Customer's declared intended end-use application for the chemical products purchased (e.g., industrial solvent, agricultural formulation, polymer additive, pharmaceutical intermediate). Required for REACH downstream user obligations and export control compliance.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA, ECHA, EAR

attributes.name: end_use_sector
attributes.description: Industry sector classification of the customer's end-use application for purchased chemicals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|construction|electronics|agriculture|pharmaceuticals|consumer_goods|coatings|textiles|food_contact|industrial — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this regulatory profile expires and must be renewed or re-validated. Null indicates an open-ended profile with no scheduled expiry.

attributes.name: export_license_number

attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), TSCA, DOT, EPA

attributes.name: ghs_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals applies to products sold to this customer, requiring GHS-compliant Safety Data Sheets and labels.

attributes.name: hazmat_transport_class
attributes.description: DOT/IATA/IMDG hazardous materials transport classification applicable to chemical products shipped to this customer (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 8 Corrosive). Governs packaging, labeling, and shipping documentation requirements.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR, IATA DGR, IMDG Code, NFPA, Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: import_license_number
attributes.description: Customer's import license or permit number issued by the destination country's regulatory authority, required for controlled or restricted chemical substances. Must be validated before shipment.
attributes.references: TSCA, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, DOT, ECHA, EPA

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory compliance audit conducted at or for this customer. Used to schedule next audit and assess compliance currency.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this regulatory profile record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and downstream data synchronization.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, SOX, SAP S/4HANA SD, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: msds_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the legacy MSDS format (pre-GHS) is required in addition to or instead of the current SDS format, applicable for customers in jurisdictions that have not fully adopted GHS.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this regulatory profile to ensure continued accuracy, completeness, and alignment with current regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: profile_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this regulatory profile, used in correspondence, audits, and regulatory submissions. Format: REGP-YYYYMMDD-CountryCode.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer regulatory profile. Active indicates all requirements are met and sales may proceed; pending_review indicates documentation is under assessment; suspended indicates a compliance hold; expired indicates the profile requires renewal.

attributes.name: profile_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer relationship type that determines applicable regulatory obligations and documentation requirements for chemical product sales.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA

attributes.name: prop65_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether California Proposition 65 (Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act) warning requirements apply to products sold to this customer based on end-use state or distribution territory.

attributes.name: reach_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the European Chemicals Agency REACH regulation applies to chemical products sold to this customer, based on destination country and product use.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the designated regulatory affairs or EHS contact at the customer organization for compliance documentation, SDS distribution, and regulatory notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated regulatory affairs or EHS contact person at the customer organization responsible for managing compliance documentation and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, ISO 14001, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: restricted_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of chemical product categories that are restricted or prohibited from sale to this customer based on regulatory, end-use, or jurisdictional constraints. Triggers order block in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA, RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: restricted_substance_ack_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer formally acknowledged the supplier's Restricted Substance List. Used to track acknowledgment currency and trigger renewal when the RSL is updated.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, ECHA

attributes.name: restricted_substance_acknowledgment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has formally acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the supplier's Restricted Substance List, confirming awareness of substances that are prohibited or restricted in supplied products.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, ECHA, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: rohs_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether EU RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) directive requirements apply to chemical products or materials sold to this customer, particularly relevant for electronics-sector customers.

attributes.name: sds_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) specifying the required language for Safety Data Sheets provided to this customer (e.g., en, de, fr, zh-CN).
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, GHS, OSHA HazCom 2012, ISO 639-1

attributes.name: special_labeling_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of any customer-specific or jurisdiction-specific labeling requirements beyond standard GHS/SDS requirements, such as additional language requirements, customer-specific hazard statements, or country-specific pictogram standards.
attributes.references: GHS, REACH CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008, OSHA HazCom 2012, NFPA 704

attributes.name: svhc_notification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires proactive notification when any supplied product contains Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) above 0.1% w/w threshold, as mandated under REACH Article 33.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Article 33, ECHA SVHC Candidate List

attributes.name: tsca_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the US EPA Toxic Substances Control Act requirements apply to chemical products sold to this customer.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Primary UN number identifying the hazardous substance or article for transport documentation purposes. Required on shipping papers, labels, and placards for regulated chemical shipments to this customer.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR, IATA DGR, IMDG Code, GHS, UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

Critical in automotive, pharma, and electronics chemical supply where customer qualification is mandatory before commercial supply.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Customer qualifications (APL entries) in chemical manufacturing are SKU-specific — a pharmaceutical or electronics customer qualifies a precise pack size and form factor, not just the base chemical. L

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Customer product qualifications in chemical manufacturing are vendor-source-specific: a customer qualifies a chemical grade from a specific supplier. If the vendor changes, re-qualification is mandato

attributes.name: apl_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the qualification record, typically assigned by the customer or jointly by the supplier and customer. Used in customer correspondence, COA references, and audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: application_use_case
attributes.description: The specific end-use application or process for which the chemical product has been qualified at the customer site (e.g., automotive coating adhesion, semiconductor etch bath, pharmaceutical excipient, agricultural formulation carrier).
attributes.references: REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals); ECHA

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer product qualification. 'approved' = fully qualified for commercial supply; 'conditionally_approved' = approved with restrictions or deviations; 'pending_review' = under evaluation; 'suspended' = temporarily halted pending investigation; 'revoked' = permanently withdrawn; 'expired' = past expiry date without renewal.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: approved_by_internal_user
attributes.description: The name or employee ID of the internal Chemical Mfg representative (e.g., technical sales, quality manager) who managed and approved the qualification from the supplier side.

attributes.name: change_notification_lead_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of calendar days advance notice required to be given to the customer before implementing any change to the qualified product. Populated only when change_notification_required_flag is True.

attributes.name: change_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires formal notification (e.g., PCN - Product Change Notification) before any change to the qualified product formulation, process, or raw material source. Critical in automotive and electronics supply chains.
attributes.references: IATF 16949; JEDEC JESD46 (Product Change Notification); ISO 9001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this qualification record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: crm_qualification_code
attributes.description: The qualification record identifier in Salesforce CRM, the system of record for customer-facing qualification activities. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational CRM.

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: The customer's own internal part number or material code assigned to this qualified chemical product. Used for cross-referencing in purchase orders, COA requests, and EDI transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Material Info Record; ANSI X12 EDI

attributes.name: customer_spec_number
attributes.description: The customer's internal specification document number that defines the quality requirements for this qualified product. Referenced on COA and COC documents during shipment.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this qualification record is binding and commercial supply may commence. May differ from qualification_date if there is a ramp-up or transition period.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this qualification is contractually binding for commercial supply. Null for open-ended qualifications. Used in supply chain planning and order management validation.

attributes.name: exclusive_supply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Chemical Mfg is the sole qualified supplier for this product at this customer site. True = exclusive supply arrangement; False = customer has multiple qualified suppliers.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer qualification expires and must be renewed or re-qualified. Null indicates an open-ended qualification with no defined expiry. Critical for supply continuity planning.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: The end-market industry segment of the customer for which this qualification applies. Drives regulatory requirements, COA content, and qualification rigor. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|electronics|pharmaceutical|agriculture|construction|consumer_goods|industrial|aerospace|food_beverage|coatings — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACC (American Chemistry Council); ECHA; FDA; IATF 16949

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this qualification record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lims_qualification_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Qualification ID
attributes.description: The qualification record identifier in LabWare LIMS, used to cross-reference lab trial data, test results, and analytical reports that supported the qualification decision.

attributes.name: max_approved_volume_kg
attributes.description: The maximum annual or periodic supply volume in kilograms approved under this qualification. Volumes exceeding this threshold require customer notification or re-qualification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Customer Supply Agreement

attributes.name: min_approved_volume_kg
attributes.description: The minimum annual or periodic supply volume in kilograms approved under this qualification. Volumes below this threshold may require re-qualification or customer notification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Customer Supply Agreement

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional qualification conditions, restrictions, or contextual information not captured in structured fields. Examples: special handling requirements, packaging restrictions, labelling requirements specific to this customer.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the product qualification was formally approved and granted by the customer. This is the effective start date for commercial supply under this qualification.

attributes.name: qualification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the product was qualified for use at the customer site. 'lab_trial' = bench-scale testing at customer or supplier lab; 'plant_trial' = full-scale production trial at customer facility; 'third_party_cert' = qualification via third-party certification body; 'desk_review' = documentation-only review; 'customer_audit' = qualification via customer site audit; 'equivalency_study' = qualification via equivalency to an already-approved product.

attributes.name: qualification_scope
attributes.description: Defines the geographic or organizational scope of the qualification. 'site_specific' = applies only to the named customer site; 'global_account' = applies across all sites of the customer account; 'regional' = applies to a defined regional cluster of sites; 'product_family' = applies to a family of related products.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: The European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) REACH registration number for the qualified substance. Required for supply into EU markets. Format: 01-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX-XX-XXXX.
attributes.references: REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals); ECHA

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_standard
attributes.description: The primary regulatory or quality standard under which this qualification was conducted (e.g., IATF 16949 for automotive, ICH Q7 for pharmaceutical API, IPC-7711 for electronics, ISO 9001 for general industrial). Drives audit and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; IATF 16949; GMP; FDA; ECHA REACH

attributes.name: renewal_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days before the expiry date that the renewal process must be initiated to ensure supply continuity. Used to trigger renewal workflow alerts in the quality management system.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification requires periodic renewal before the expiry date. True = renewal process must be initiated; False = qualification is perpetual or renewal is not contractually required.

attributes.name: spec_deviation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of any customer-approved deviations from the standard product specification included in this qualification. Populated only when spec_deviation_flag is True.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) Process

attributes.name: spec_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification includes customer-approved deviations from the standard product specification. True = one or more approved deviations exist; False = qualification is to standard specification.

attributes.name: volume_period
attributes.description: The time period to which the approved volume range (min/max) applies. Defines whether volume limits are annual, quarterly, monthly, or per-order constraints.

products.name: interaction
products.description: Log of all customer-facing interactions and touchpoints including sales calls, technical visits, complaint calls, email exchanges, webinar attendance, trade show meetings, and portal logins. Captures interaction type, channel (phone, email, in-person, video, portal), date and time, duration, participants (internal and customer contacts), subject, outcome, follow-up actions, and linked opportunity or case. Sourced from Salesforce CRM activity records. Supports customer relationship management and account planning.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer interaction record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the interaction data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (account) involved in this interaction. Links to the customer master data product.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service case or complaint record linked to this interaction, if applicable. Supports complaint resolution tracking and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; Intelex EHS CAPA Module

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Supports support interaction logs tying each customer interaction to the specific chemical product discussed, required for service quality metrics.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer contact person who participated in this interaction. Links to the customer contact data product.

attributes.name: customer_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer site or plant location where the interaction occurred or is relevant to. Supports site-level account management and technical service tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Site; SAP S/4HANA SD Ship-To Party

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity linked to this interaction, if applicable. Enables tracking of interactions that advance a specific sales pursuit.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Interaction Log per Order ties customer/technical interactions to a specific sales order, enabling SLA measurement and order‑level support metrics.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: Customer interactions in chemical sales frequently involve quote presentations, price negotiations, and quote follow-ups. Linking interaction to quote enables CRM tracking of which quotes were discuss

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ehs.safety_data_sheet. Business justification: SDS request fulfillment process: customer interactions flagged sds_request_flag=true represent formal SDS distribution events (OSHA HazCom 2012, REACH). Linking the interaction to the specific SDS doc

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the interaction was conducted. Supports omnichannel analytics and customer engagement reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Channel; ISO 9001 Customer Communication

attributes.name: coa_request_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requested a Certificate of Analysis (COA) during this interaction. Supports quality document fulfillment tracking and customer quality management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management; LabWare LIMS COA Module

attributes.name: complaint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involves or originated from a customer complaint. Triggers linkage to the complaint/case management workflow and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) process.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction; Salesforce CRM Case

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this interaction record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CreatedDate; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: crm_activity_code
attributes.description: External identifier from Salesforce CRM activity record. Used to trace the interaction back to the system of record for reconciliation and lineage.

attributes.name: customer_participant_count
attributes.description: Number of customer-side contacts who participated in the interaction. Indicates the breadth of customer engagement and stakeholder involvement.

attributes.name: customer_participants
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer contact names or identifiers who participated in the interaction. Confidential business relationship data.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Invitees; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Numeric satisfaction rating provided by the customer or assessed by the account manager following the interaction, typically on a 1-5 or 1-10 scale. Supports Key Performance Indicator (KPI) tracking for customer relationship health.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total elapsed time of the interaction in minutes. Used to assess engagement depth, resource utilization, and account planning efficiency.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the required follow-up action must be completed. Used for task management and account manager accountability tracking.

attributes.name: follow_up_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific follow-up actions committed to during the interaction. Captures commitments made to the customer for accountability and continuity.

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up action or subsequent interaction is required as a result of this interaction. Drives task creation and account planning workflows.

attributes.name: interaction_date

products.name: case
products.description: Customer service cases and support tickets covering the full spectrum of customer issues: technical assistance requests, order discrepancies, documentation requests (SDS, COA, COC), regulatory inquiries, and quality/OOS product complaints. This is the single source of truth for all customer-initiated issues and complaints. Captures case number, case type (technical support, order issue, SDS request, COA request, regulatory inquiry, quality complaint), priority, severity, status (open, in progress, resolved, closed), assigned service rep, SLA due date, resolution description, customer satisfaction rating. For quality complaints: product involved, lot number, batch reference, COA reference, complaint description, root cause investigation (RCI) status, CAPA reference, severity classification, credit note issued flag, and customer satisfaction outcome. Integrates with LabWare LIMS for OOS investigation, SAP QM for CAPA tracking, and Salesforce CRM Case object as system of record. Supports 8D problem-solving workflow for quality complaints.

domains.name: production
domains.description: Core manufacturing execution domain managing batch and continuous chemical processes, reaction sequences, synthesis operations, and production runs. Includes production orders, batch records, process parameters (temperature, pressure, pH), DCS/PLC integration data (Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7), MES execution logs, yield tracking, lot genealogy, BOM consumption, MOC records, and production scheduling. Captures real-time process data from SCADA systems and maintains production history for traceability and process optimization (SPC, OEE).

products.name: manufacturing_order
products.description: Core execution entity authorizing and tracking the manufacture of a chemical product or intermediate, serving as the single ISA-95 Level 3 production order and ISA-88 batch control entity. Captures order number, order type (batch/continuous/semi-continuous), master recipe reference (PI sheet), process order type, planned and actual quantities, unit of measure, scheduled and actual start/finish dates, order status lifecycle (created, released, started, confirmed, technically complete, closed), priority, plant, work center assignment, BOM reference, routing/recipe reference, production version, MES integration ID, DCS control recipe destination, phase sequence, settlement rule, cost estimate vs actual cost, yield target, and variance analysis flags. The single source of truth for 'what are we making, when, and how much' — the central entity that batch records, BOM consumption, yield records, deviations, and campaigns all reference.

products.description: Electronic Batch Record (EBR) and complete MES execution audit trail serving as the authoritative manufacturing history for a single production batch (21 CFR Part 11 compliant). Captures batch number (LOT), batch size, batch status (in-process, released, rejected, quarantine), manufacturing date, expiry/retest dates, manufacturing order reference, formula/recipe version, and the full step-by-step execution log: MES transaction IDs, recipe phases executed, execution start/end timestamps per step, operator IDs, equipment IDs, actual parameter values entered, electronic signatures (21 CFR Part 11), instruction text displayed, operator responses/confirmations, exception flags, deviation count, review/approval signatures, GMP compliance flag, COA linkage, regulatory hold flags, and MES system version. The single authoritative document for batch genealogy tracing, regulatory audits, GMP batch release, electronic records compliance, and production floor execution verification.

attributes.name: standard_cost_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.standard_cost. Business justification: Yield variance reporting in chemical manufacturing requires the standard cost per unit to calculate the financial value of yield losses. Linking yield_record to standard_cost enables automated yield v

attributes.name: waste_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ehs.waste_stream. Business justification: Yield records capture waste_quantity and waste_classification attributes, confirming waste generation tracking. Linking yield records to the specific waste stream enables RCRA and TRI regulatory waste

attributes.name: actual_yield_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of product produced and confirmed in the production run. This is the measured output after completion of the batch.
attributes.references: SAP PP - Production Planning, GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: by_product_code
attributes.description: The material code or SKU for the by-product generated. References the by-product master data in the materials management system.

attributes.name: by_product_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of by-products or co-products generated during the production process. By-products may have commercial value or require disposal.
attributes.references: SAP PP - Production Planning, Environmental Reporting

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The source system from which the yield data was captured. Indicates whether data originated from SAP PP, MES, DCS (Honeywell Experion or Siemens PCS 7), LIMS, or manual entry.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The quality inspection lot number assigned to this batch for QC testing. Links yield records to quality inspection results and COA (Certificate of Analysis) data.
attributes.references: SAP QM - Quality Management, LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System)

attributes.name: loss_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the primary reason for yield loss. Used for root cause analysis, process improvement, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) initiatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: evaporation|spillage|sampling|reaction_inefficiency|filtration_loss|equipment_holdup|transfer_loss|quality_rejection|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), RCI (Root Cause Investigation)

attributes.name: planned_yield_quantity
attributes.description: The theoretical or planned yield quantity expected from the production order based on the Bill of Materials (BOM) and process parameters. Represents the target output under ideal conditions.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or facility where the production occurred. Aligns with SAP plant master data.

attributes.name: process_order_type
attributes.description: The type of production process used for this yield record. Distinguishes between batch processing, continuous processing, semi-batch, or campaign manufacturing modes.
attributes.references: ISA-95 - Enterprise-Control System Integration, SAP PP

attributes.name: production_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production batch or run was completed and yield was confirmed. Used for cycle time analysis and OEE calculation.
attributes.references: ISA-95 - Enterprise-Control System Integration, OEE Standards

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the production line, reactor, or processing unit where the batch was manufactured. May reference DCS (Distributed Control System) or MES (Manufacturing Execution System) equipment identifiers.

attributes.name: production_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production batch or run was started. Captured from MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or DCS (Distributed Control System) logs.
attributes.references: ISA-95 - Enterprise-Control System Integration, SAP PP

attributes.name: quality_status
attributes.description: The quality control status of the batch. Indicates whether the batch has been approved for release, is pending QC testing, or has been rejected. Links to Certificate of Analysis (COA) and quality inspection results.
attributes.references: SAP QM - Quality Management, GMP, ISO 9001

attributes.name: raw_material_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of raw materials consumed in this production run. Used for cost accounting, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, and yield-based profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO - Controlling, FASB (Financial Accounting Standards Board)

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: The version of the production recipe or master formula used for this batch. Critical for traceability and Management of Change (MOC) compliance.
attributes.references: MOC (Management of Change), GMP, ISA-88 - Batch Control

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this yield record was first created in the data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this yield record was last modified. Critical for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or supervisor comments regarding yield performance, process deviations, or special conditions during production. Used for batch record documentation and deviation investigations.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), Batch Record Requirements

attributes.name: theoretical_yield_basis
attributes.description: The method or basis used to calculate the planned yield. Indicates whether the theoretical yield was derived from BOM standards, process simulation (e.g., Aspen HYSYS), historical averages, or lab/pilot scale data.
attributes.references: SAP PP - Production Planning, Process Engineering Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for yield quantities (e.g., kilograms, liters, metric tons). Must align with product master data and BOM unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|L|mL|MT|lb|gal|ton|m3 — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000 - Quantities and Units, SAP MM

attributes.name: variance_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The acceptable variance threshold percentage used to determine if yield_variance_flag should be set. Typically defined in process control plans or SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures).
attributes.references: SPC (Statistical Process Control), SOP (Standard Operating Procedure)

attributes.name: waste_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the waste material for environmental and regulatory purposes. Indicates whether waste is hazardous, contains VOC (Volatile Organic Compounds), HAP (Hazardous Air Pollutants), or is recyclable.
attributes.references: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act), OSHA

attributes.name: waste_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of waste material generated during production that requires disposal or treatment. Critical for environmental reporting and TRI (Toxics Release Inventory) compliance.
attributes.references: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), TRI (Toxics Release Inventory), ISO 14001

attributes.name: yield_confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the actual yield quantity was confirmed and recorded in the system. May differ from production_end_timestamp if post-production weighing or measurement is required.

attributes.name: yield_efficiency_score
attributes.description: A normalized efficiency score (0-100) that factors in yield percentage, quality status, and process losses. Used for benchmarking and continuous improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), SPC (Statistical Process Control)

attributes.name: yield_loss_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity of material lost during the production process due to evaporation, spillage, sampling, filtration loss, reaction inefficiency, or other process losses. Represents unrecoverable material.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), Process Safety Management (PSM)

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: The yield efficiency expressed as a percentage, calculated as (actual_yield_quantity / planned_yield_quantity) * 100. Key performance indicator for process efficiency and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation.
attributes.references: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), SPC (Statistical Process Control)

attributes.name: yield_variance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the yield variance exceeds acceptable tolerance limits. True indicates an out-of-specification (OOS) or out-of-trend (OOT) condition requiring investigation.

attributes.name: yield_variance_quantity
attributes.description: The absolute difference between planned and actual yield (planned_yield_quantity - actual_yield_quantity). Positive values indicate under-production; negative values indicate over-production.
attributes.references: SAP CO - Controlling, Cost Accounting Standards

products.name: schedule
products.description: Master production schedule (MPS) record defining planned production runs across work centers and production lines for a planning horizon. Captures schedule ID, planning period, work center, product/material number, planned quantity, scheduled start datetime, scheduled end datetime, schedule status (planned, firmed, released, completed), capacity requirement, priority rank, campaign flag (for multi-batch campaigns), changeover time, and scheduling constraint notes. Integrates with SAP PP capacity planning and MES scheduling modules.
products.reference: Master Production Schedule (MPS) / SAP PP Planned Order

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for schedule

attributes.name: bill_of_materials_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials that defines the raw material components and quantities required for this scheduled production.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this schedule to a production campaign when campaign_flag is true. Multiple schedules may share the same campaign ID.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Production scheduling aligns planned quantities with product master data for capacity planning and compliance.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast that is driving this production schedule, if this is make-to-stock production.

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality control plan that defines the inspection points, test methods, and acceptance criteria for this scheduled production.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent production order that this schedule is fulfilling.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer sales order that is driving this production schedule, if this is make-to-order production.

attributes.name: production_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.production_plan. Business justification: Production schedules are derived from and must reconcile with production plans. Chemical manufacturing S&OP processes require tracing each production schedule back to the authorizing production plan f

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.production_schedule. Business justification: The planning-domain production_schedule is the upstream driver of the production-domain schedule. Chemical manufacturing execution systems need this link to confirm that production schedules are execu

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: SCHEDULE: Production schedules are driven by sales quotes; FK provides end‑to‑end visibility from quote to scheduled capacity.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing that defines the sequence of operations, work centers, and process parameters for manufacturing this product.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Links production schedules to the specific stock positions reserved for the scheduled quantities.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production line where the scheduled production will occur.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: The standard batch size for this production schedule. In batch chemical manufacturing, this represents the quantity produced in a single reactor charge or process cycle.

attributes.name: campaign_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is part of a multi-batch production campaign where the same product is manufactured continuously across multiple batches to optimize changeover time and yield.

attributes.name: capacity_requirement_hours
attributes.description: The total work center capacity required to complete this schedule, expressed in machine hours or labor hours.

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes
attributes.description: The estimated time in minutes required to changeover the work center from the previous product to this scheduled product, including cleaning (CIP), equipment reconfiguration, and line clearance.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this scheduled production was completed and confirmed in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference to the environmental permit or air quality permit required for this production, particularly for processes that emit VOCs (Volatile Organic Compounds) or HAPs (Hazardous Air Pollutants).
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Title V Operating Permits

attributes.name: expected_yield_percentage
attributes.description: The expected production yield as a percentage of theoretical maximum, accounting for normal process losses, waste, and off-spec material.

attributes.name: frozen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is frozen and locked from further changes, typically within the frozen planning horizon where changes require special approval.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this schedule record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: moc_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Management of Change record if this schedule involves a process change, new formulation, or deviation from standard operating procedures.

attributes.name: number_of_batches
attributes.description: The total number of batches required to fulfill the planned quantity for this schedule.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The target quantity of product to be manufactured in this schedule, expressed in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: planning_period
attributes.description: The planning horizon period for this schedule entry, expressed as year-quarter, year-month, or year-week (e.g., 2024-Q2, 2024-M06, 2024-W23).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for scheduling sequence, where lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for sequencing when multiple schedules compete for the same work center.

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: The specific production line or reactor train within the work center where this schedule will be executed.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this schedule was released for execution to the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) or shop floor.

attributes.name: run_time_minutes
attributes.description: The estimated production run time in minutes to manufacture the planned quantity, excluding setup and changeover.

attributes.name: safety_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule requires a safety review or Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) before execution, typically for new products, process changes, or hazardous materials.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the production schedule, externally visible and used for tracking and communication across planning and execution teams.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production schedule: planned (initial draft), firmed (committed but not released), released (authorized for execution), in_progress (actively running), completed (finished), cancelled (voided).

attributes.name: scheduled_end_datetime
attributes.description: The planned date and time when production is scheduled to complete for this schedule entry.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime
attributes.description: The planned date and time when production is scheduled to begin for this schedule entry.

attributes.name: scheduling_constraint_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing any special scheduling constraints, dependencies, or considerations such as raw material availability, regulatory windows, customer delivery commitments, or equipment maintenance windows.

attributes.name: scheduling_method
attributes.description: The scheduling algorithm used to create this schedule: forward (from earliest start), backward (from required delivery), finite (capacity-constrained), or infinite (capacity-unconstrained).

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: The time in minutes required to set up equipment, load raw materials, and prepare the work center before production can begin.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: The shift pattern during which this production is scheduled to run (day, night, swing, continuous 24/7, or weekend).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the planned quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|L|MT|GAL|LB|TON|M3|EA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: work_center
products.description: Master data for production work centers, reactors, vessels, blending units, and processing lines within the chemical plant. Captures work center ID, work center name, work center type (reactor, blender, distillation column, filtration unit, packaging line), plant, cost center reference, capacity category, available capacity (hours/day), efficiency factor, utilization rate, OEE target, DCS system ID (Honeywell Experion or Siemens PCS 7 node), equipment list, and operational status. SSOT for production capacity and equipment assignment within the production domain.

attributes.name: batch_size_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for batch size specifications (minimum and maximum) for this work center.

attributes.name: capacity_category
attributes.description: Classification of capacity type used for production planning and scheduling calculations in SAP PP.

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_rate_percent
attributes.description: Current capacity utilization rate expressed as a percentage, indicating how much of available capacity is being used.

attributes.name: cip_clean_in_place_capable_flag

attributes.name: commissioning_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: crew_size_standard
attributes.description: Standard number of operators or crew members required to operate this work center during normal production.

attributes.name: dcs_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the DCS (Distributed Control System) node or controller managing this work center. Typically references Honeywell Experion or Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7 system nodes.

attributes.name: dcs_system_type
attributes.description: Type or vendor of the DCS system controlling this work center for process automation and monitoring.

attributes.name: efficiency_factor_percent
attributes.description: Standard efficiency factor applied to capacity calculations, representing the expected performance level relative to theoretical maximum.

attributes.name: ehs_permit_required_flag

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: maximum_batch_size
attributes.description: Maximum production batch size that can be processed at this work center, expressed in the standard unit of measure.

attributes.name: minimum_batch_size
attributes.description: Minimum production batch size that can be processed at this work center, expressed in the standard unit of measure.

attributes.name: next_psr_due_date

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date

attributes.name: oee_target_percent

attributes.name: operational_status

attributes.name: plc_controller_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) managing discrete control functions for this work center.

attributes.name: pressure_control_capability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center has automated pressure control capabilities for process management.

attributes.name: psr_process_safety_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent Process Safety Review or Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) conducted for this work center.

attributes.name: scada_node_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Node ID
attributes.description: SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system node identifier for real-time monitoring and data collection from this work center.

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard setup or changeover time in minutes required to prepare this work center for a new production run or product.

attributes.name: teardown_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard teardown or cleanup time in minutes required after completing a production run at this work center.

attributes.name: temperature_control_capability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center has automated temperature control capabilities for process management.

attributes.name: work_center_category
attributes.description: Operational category indicating the processing mode and operational characteristics of the work center.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the work center used in production planning and scheduling systems. Typically sourced from SAP PP (Production Planning) module.

attributes.name: work_center_name

attributes.name: work_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work center based on its primary production function within the chemical manufacturing process.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative catalog of finished chemical products, formulations, grades, and SKUs offered to customers. Manages product specifications, technical data sheets, GHS classification, SDS document linkage, regulatory status (REACH, TSCA), application guidelines, packaging configurations, product lifecycle state, product hierarchies, and cross-references. Covers performance materials, plastics, agricultural solutions, and specialty chemicals.

products.name: chemical_product
products.description: Core master record for every finished chemical product, performance material, plastic, agricultural solution, or specialty chemical offered to customers. Captures authoritative product identity: product name, trade name, chemical name, CAS number, product family, product line, business unit, product type (bulk, packaged, specialty), physical form (liquid, solid, powder, gas), product lifecycle state (active, discontinued, developmental, phased_out), introduction date, discontinuation date, internal product code, storage temperature range, shelf life, and hazmat transport classification (UN number, hazard class, packing group). This is the SSOT for all product identity in the enterprise — SAP S/4HANA Material Master (MM) is the system of record.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.hazmat_storage_rule. attributes.name: packing_group

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH measurement indicating acidity or alkalinity on a 0-14 scale. Critical for corrosivity assessment, handling requirements, and application compatibility.

attributes.name: physical_form
attributes.description: Physical state of the product at standard temperature and pressure. Critical for storage requirements, handling procedures, and transportation classification.
