attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: ECHA registration number for substances manufactured or imported into the EU above 1 tonne per year. Required for legal sale in EU markets.

attributes.name: reach_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Status
attributes.description: Current REACH compliance status. Registered: full dossier submitted. Pre-registered: intent declared. Exempt: below tonnage threshold or exempted substance. Not Applicable: not sold in EU. Pending: registration in progress.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product maintains specification quality under proper storage conditions from manufacturing date. Used for FEFO inventory management and expiration tracking.

attributes.name: standard_cost_usd
attributes.description: Standard manufacturing cost per base unit in USD. Used for inventory valuation, margin analysis, and financial reporting. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum safe storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Exceeding this temperature may degrade product quality or create safety hazards.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum safe storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Critical for warehouse environmental controls and product quality preservation.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Registered trademark or brand name under which the product is sold. May differ from the technical product name for marketing purposes.

attributes.name: tsca_status
attributes.description: EPA TSCA inventory status for US market. Active: on inventory and commercially used. Inactive: on inventory but not currently manufactured. Exempt: polymer or other exemption. Not On Inventory: requires PMN before manufacture.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport. Required on shipping documents, labels, and placards per DOT and international transport regulations.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: viscosity_cps
attributes.description: Dynamic viscosity measured in centipoise at standard temperature. Affects pumping requirements, mixing behavior, and application characteristics.

attributes.name: voc_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of volatile organic compounds by weight. Subject to EPA and state air quality regulations. Critical for environmental compliance and emissions reporting.

products.name: sku
products.description: Stock Keeping Unit record representing a specific orderable and shippable configuration of a chemical product. Each SKU maps to a unique combination of product, grade, packaging type, pack size, and unit of measure. Captures SKU code, description, net weight, gross weight, unit of measure (kg, L, MT, drum, IBC, bag), packaging type, hazard class, UN number, shelf life (days), storage temperature range, minimum order quantity (MOQ), and SKU status. Links to the parent chemical_product and to packaging_config. SAP SD material variant is the system of record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent chemical product that this SKU represents a specific orderable configuration of.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grade. Business justification: sku has a denormalized `grade` STRING field. The grade table is the authoritative record for quality grades (Technical Grade, USP, ACS Reagent, etc.). A SKU is defined in part by its grade — e.g., a 2

attributes.name: maintenance_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.plant. Business justification: SKUs are produced and packaged at specific plants. Plant-level SKU availability drives ATP (available-to-promise) calculations, shipping point determination, and hazmat compliance documentation. Chemi

attributes.name: packaging_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_config. Business justification: A SKU is fundamentally defined by its packaging configuration — a 200L drum vs. a 1000L IBC vs. a 25kg bag are different SKUs. packaging_config is the authoritative master for approved packaging forma

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the current Safety Data Sheet document for this SKU. SDS provides hazard information and safe handling instructions.

attributes.name: tds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the Technical Data Sheet document containing product specifications, properties, and application guidelines.

attributes.name: application_area
attributes.description: Primary industry or application area where this SKU is used (e.g., Automotive, Construction, Electronics, Agriculture, Pharmaceuticals, Water Treatment).

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Machine-readable barcode identifier (UPC, EAN, or GS1-128) printed on product packaging for scanning in warehouse and logistics operations.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Used for regulatory reporting and SDS documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was or will be discontinued and removed from the active product catalog. Null for active SKUs.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU configuration became available for ordering and shipping. Used for product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors of the chemical will ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical safety parameter for flammable liquids.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification codes (e.g., H226, H302, H315) describing the chemical hazards of this product. Used for SDS and labeling.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight including product and packaging materials per package, measured in kilograms. Used for freight calculations and shipping documentation.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying this SKU in the global supply chain. Used for EDI transactions and retail distribution.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard classification for transportation (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 8 Corrosive). Required for shipping documentation and compliance.

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this chemical is a controlled substance requiring special licensing, reporting, and security measures under DEA or EPA regulations.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this SKU is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation procedures.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered for this SKU. Used in sales order validation and customer quotations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|l|mt|gal|lb|drum|ibc|bag|ea — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the chemical product content per package, excluding packaging materials, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Quantity of product contained in one package unit. Used with unit_of_measure to define the orderable quantity.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH measurement indicating acidity or alkalinity of the chemical product on a scale of 0-14. Important for handling, compatibility, and application.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: European REACH registration number for this chemical substance. Required for sales in EU markets.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days from manufacturing date that the product maintains its specified quality and performance characteristics under proper storage conditions.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this specific SKU configuration. Used in ordering, shipping, and inventory systems.

attributes.name: sku_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the SKU including product name, grade, packaging type, and size. Used on sales orders, shipping documents, and invoices.

attributes.name: sku_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU. Active SKUs are orderable; inactive and discontinued SKUs cannot be ordered; blocked SKUs are temporarily unavailable.

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Ratio of the density of the chemical to the density of water at a specified temperature. Used for volume-to-weight conversions and quality control.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius at which the product must be stored to maintain stability and quality.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius at which the product must be stored to maintain stability and quality.

attributes.name: tsca_status
attributes.description: Status of the chemical substance under US EPA TSCA inventory. Listed substances can be manufactured or imported in the US.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport. Required on shipping papers, labels, and placards.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the pack size (kilograms, liters, metric tons, gallons, pounds, drums, intermediate bulk containers, bags, each). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|l|mt|gal|lb|drum|ibc|bag|ea — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: grade
products.description: Defines the quality grades and purity tiers available for a chemical product (e.g., Technical Grade, Reagent Grade, Food Grade, Pharmaceutical Grade, Electronic Grade, Agricultural Grade). Captures grade code, grade name, grade description, minimum purity percentage, applicable regulatory standards (GMP, USP, EP, FCC), intended application sector, and grade-specific handling requirements. A single chemical product may have multiple grades, each with distinct specifications and pricing. Owned by the product domain as part of the product catalog.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product grade record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent chemical product for which this grade is defined. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) document for this grade. Critical for EHS (Environment Health and Safety) compliance.

attributes.name: tds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the technical data sheet document containing detailed specifications, properties, and application guidelines for this grade.

attributes.name: acs_reagent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade meets American Chemical Society (ACS) reagent specifications for laboratory and analytical use.

attributes.name: application_sector
attributes.description: Primary industry sector or application area for which this grade is intended (e.g., pharmaceutical, food and beverage, electronics, agriculture, industrial manufacturing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pharmaceutical|food_beverage|electronics|agriculture|industrial|research_laboratory|cosmetics|automotive|construction — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: base_price_per_kg
attributes.description: Standard base price per kilogram for this grade in the default currency, used as a reference for pricing agreements and quotations. Subject to volume discounts and contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Master, Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS (Chemical Abstracts Service) Registry Number uniquely identifying the chemical substance for this grade. Standard format: XXXXXX-XX-X.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must be issued with each lot or shipment of this grade, typically required for pharmaceutical, food, and high-purity grades.

attributes.name: certificate_of_compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Compliance (COC) must be issued with shipments of this grade, certifying conformance to regulatory and customer specifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product grade record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this grade was discontinued or withdrawn from the catalog. Null for active grades. Used for product lifecycle tracking and phase-out management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this grade became available for sale and production. Used for product lifecycle tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: ep_grade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade meets European Pharmacopoeia (EP) monograph standards for pharmaceutical use in European markets.

attributes.name: fcc_grade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade meets Food Chemicals Codex (FCC) standards for food-contact and food-additive applications.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard classification codes applicable to this grade (e.g., H302, H315, H319). Used for Safety Data Sheet (SDS) generation and labeling compliance.
attributes.references: GHS (UN Globally Harmonized System), OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade is manufactured under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards, required for pharmaceutical and food-contact applications.

attributes.name: grade_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the grade within the product catalog (e.g., TG, RG, FG, PG, EG, AG for Technical, Reagent, Food, Pharmaceutical, Electronic, Agricultural grades).

attributes.name: grade_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the grade, including its intended use, distinguishing characteristics, and typical applications.

attributes.name: grade_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the grade (e.g., Technical Grade, Reagent Grade, Food Grade, Pharmaceutical Grade, Electronic Grade, Agricultural Grade).

attributes.name: grade_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product grade in the catalog. Determines availability for sales and production.

attributes.name: handling_requirements
attributes.description: Special handling, storage, and safety requirements specific to this grade (e.g., temperature control, moisture sensitivity, inert atmosphere, light protection). References Safety Data Sheet (SDS) and Process Safety Management (PSM) protocols.
attributes.references: SDS (Safety Data Sheet), OSHA PSM, Internal EHS Procedures

attributes.name: intended_use_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the intended applications and use cases for this grade, including typical customer processes and end-product integration.
attributes.references: Product Technical Data Sheet, Application Guidelines

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product grade record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production and delivery lead time in days for this grade, used for order promising and supply chain planning.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Planning, Supply Chain Policy

attributes.name: maximum_impurity_ppm
attributes.description: Maximum allowable impurity concentration in parts per million (PPM) for this grade. Used in quality specifications and Certificate of Analysis (COA).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Internal QC Standards

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity_kg
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) in kilograms for this grade, driven by production batch economics and packaging constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_purity_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum chemical purity level required for this grade, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.50 for 99.5% purity). Critical for Quality Control (QC) and Certificate of Analysis (COA) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Internal QC Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or comments related to this grade that do not fit in structured fields.

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Standard packaging options available for this grade (e.g., 25kg bags, 200L drums, 1000L IBC totes, bulk tanker). May list multiple configurations separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier classification for this grade, reflecting the quality level and market positioning. Higher purity and specialty grades typically command premium pricing.
attributes.references: Internal Pricing Strategy, SAP SD Pricing

attributes.name: reach_registered_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade is registered under the European REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation for sale in the EU.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Primary regulatory classification or standard applicable to this grade (e.g., GMP-compliant, USP Grade, EP Grade, FCC Grade, ACS Reagent). May reference multiple standards separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: FDA, USP (United States Pharmacopeia), EP (European Pharmacopoeia), FCC (Food Chemicals Codex), ACS (American Chemical Society)

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Expected shelf life of this grade in months under proper storage conditions, used for inventory management (FEFO - First Expired First Out) and lot tracking.
attributes.references: Product Stability Studies, Internal Quality Standards

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain grade specifications and product stability.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain grade specifications and product stability.

attributes.name: tsca_listed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Listed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade is listed on the EPA TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act) inventory for commercial use in the United States.

attributes.name: usp_grade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade meets United States Pharmacopeia (USP) monograph standards for pharmaceutical use.

products.name: product_specification
products.description: Authoritative technical specification record for a chemical product, grade, or SKU, defining the quality parameters and acceptance criteria used in COA/COC generation and QC release. Captures specification version, effective date, expiry date, specification type (release, in-process, shelf-life, stability), parameter name (assay, pH, viscosity, moisture, color, density, particle size, heavy metals, residual solvents), test method reference (ASTM, ISO, USP, internal), minimum value, maximum value, target value, unit of measure, specification status, and approval authority. Versioned to support lifecycle changes and regulatory audit trail. Links to LabWare LIMS for test execution and to quality domain for COA generation.

attributes.name: product_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product specification record. Primary key for the product specification entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom this specification is defined. Nullable for standard specifications. Populated for customer-specific specifications that define unique quality requirements per contract or technical agreement.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product, grade, or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) that this specification applies to. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grade. Business justification: product_specification defines technical specifications for a chemical product, grade, or SKU (per its description). It already has chemical_product_id. Adding nullable grade_id enables grade-specific

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sds. Business justification: product_specification has an `sds_section_reference` STRING field that references a specific section within an SDS document. Adding sds_id FK normalizes the reference to the SDS master record, while k

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: product_specification's description explicitly states it covers 'a chemical product, grade, or SKU.' Adding nullable sku_id enables SKU-level specifications — customer-specific specs (customer_specifi

attributes.name: superseded_specification_product_specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous specification version that this version replaces. Nullable for initial specifications. Supports version history tracking and regulatory audit trail for specification changes.

attributes.name: tds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.tds. Business justification: product_specification defines technical parameters with test methods and acceptance criteria. These specifications are often derived from or aligned with the Technical Data Sheet (TDS). Adding nullabl

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Textual description of the acceptance rule for this parameter. Used for qualitative assessments or complex criteria that cannot be expressed as simple numeric ranges (e.g., 'clear colorless liquid', 'no visible particulates', 'conforms to reference standard').
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Role or individual responsible for approving this specification version. Typically Quality Assurance (QA) manager, regulatory affairs director, or technical director. Required for audit trail and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and ISO 9001.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, 21 CFR Part 211 - GMP

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this specification version was formally approved. Establishes the audit trail for specification lifecycle management and supports Management of Change (MOC) processes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this specification version. Captured for regulatory audit trail and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) documentation requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for creating this specification version. Documents the reason for specification changes as required by Management of Change (MOC) processes. Examples include regulatory update, process improvement, customer requirement, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) response.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, OSHA PSM 1910.119

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and regulatory compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) documentation requirements.

attributes.name: criticality_level
attributes.description: Classification of the parameter's importance to product quality and safety. Critical parameters directly impact safety or efficacy and trigger immediate batch rejection if Out of Specification (OOS). Major parameters affect product performance. Minor parameters are informational or aesthetic.

attributes.name: customer_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specification is tailored for a specific customer contract or represents the standard product specification. True if customer-specific, false if standard. Customer-specific specifications may have tighter limits or additional parameters.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Link to the full specification document stored in the document management system. Provides access to detailed test procedures, sampling instructions, and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this specification version becomes binding for quality control testing and release decisions. Used to determine which specification applies to a given production batch or lot.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this specification version is no longer valid for new testing. Nullable for specifications with indefinite validity. Superseded specifications retain expiry date for audit purposes.

attributes.name: ghs_classification_relevance
attributes.description: Describes how this specification parameter relates to Globally Harmonized System (GHS) hazard classification and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) content. For example, pH specifications may determine corrosivity classification; VOC content affects environmental hazard labeling.
attributes.references: GHS Rev. 9 - UN Globally Harmonized System

attributes.name: iso_standard_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Standard Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) standard that governs this specification parameter or test method. Examples include ISO 9001 for quality management, ISO 14001 for environmental parameters, ISO 17025 for testing competence.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this specification record. Required for audit trail and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this specification record. Tracks changes for audit trail and supports Management of Change (MOC) processes.

attributes.name: lims_test_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Test Code
attributes.description: Test code or identifier in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) used to execute this specification parameter. Links this specification to LabWare LIMS for test execution, result capture, and Certificate of Analysis (COA) generation.

attributes.name: maximum_value
attributes.description: Upper acceptance limit for the quality parameter. Test results above this value indicate Out of Specification (OOS) condition. Nullable for parameters with only lower limits.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: minimum_value
attributes.description: Lower acceptance limit for the quality parameter. Test results below this value indicate Out of Specification (OOS) condition. Nullable for parameters with only upper limits.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, instructions, or context for this specification parameter. May include special handling instructions, historical context, or clarifications for laboratory technicians and Quality Control (QC) personnel.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality parameter being specified. Examples include assay, pH (Potential of Hydrogen), viscosity, moisture content, color, density, particle size, heavy metals concentration, residual solvents, Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) content, and other chemical or physical properties.

attributes.name: reach_registration_relevance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Relevance
attributes.description: Describes how this specification parameter supports Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) registration and compliance. For example, impurity limits may be required to demonstrate substance identity and composition per REACH dossier.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parameter is mandated by regulatory authorities such as Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH), Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA), or Food and Drug Administration (FDA). True if regulatory-mandated, false if internal quality control only.

attributes.name: sampling_plan
attributes.description: Description of the sampling strategy for this parameter. Defines sample size, sampling frequency, and sampling points (e.g., 'three samples from top, middle, bottom of batch', 'composite sample from each reactor vessel'). Links to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 - Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: sds_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the section of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) where this specification parameter is documented. Supports linkage between quality specifications and safety documentation.
attributes.references: GHS Rev. 9 - UN Globally Harmonized System, OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the specification document. Externally-known unique code used in Certificate of Analysis (COA) and Certificate of Compliance (COC) generation.

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the specification. Active specifications are used for Certificate of Analysis (COA) generation and Quality Control (QC) release decisions. Superseded specifications are retained for audit trail.

attributes.name: specification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specification based on its purpose in the quality control lifecycle. Release specifications define final product acceptance criteria; in-process specifications govern intermediate checkpoints; shelf-life and stability specifications define storage and aging limits.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Ideal or nominal value for the quality parameter. Used for Statistical Process Control (SPC) and process optimization. Nullable for parameters defined only by acceptance ranges.

attributes.name: test_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this parameter must be tested. Per-batch and per-lot testing occur for every production run. Periodic testing (daily, weekly, monthly) applies to stability and shelf-life specifications. On-demand testing is triggered by specific events or investigations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: per-batch|per-lot|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|on-demand — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: test_method_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized or internal test method used to measure this parameter. May reference ASTM (American Society for Testing and Materials), ISO (International Organization for Standardization), USP (United States Pharmacopeia), or internal Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) codes.

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_relevance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Relevance
attributes.description: Describes how this specification parameter supports Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) compliance and reporting. For example, residual monomer content may be required for TSCA inventory listing or Chemical Data Reporting (CDR).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the parameter value is expressed. Examples include Parts Per Million (PPM), percent, pH units, centipoise (cP) for viscosity, grams per cubic centimeter (g/cm³) for density, microns for particle size. Must align with test method reference.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the specification to support lifecycle changes and regulatory audit trail. Follows major.minor versioning convention.

products.name: tds
products.description: Technical Data Sheet (TDS) document record for a chemical product, capturing the authoritative technical and application information published to customers and distributors. Stores TDS document number, version, effective date, language, product applications, physical and chemical properties summary, handling and storage guidance, recommended use concentrations, compatibility notes, performance data references, and document URL/path. Versioned and linked to the parent chemical_product. Supports customer technical sales and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: tds_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the technical data sheet record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent chemical product for which this TDS is published. Links to the chemical_product master data.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sds. Business justification: tds (Technical Data Sheet) has a denormalized `sds_document_number` STRING field that references the associated SDS document. The sds table is the authoritative SDS master record. TDS and SDS are comp

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Visual appearance characteristics of the product such as color, clarity, and texture. Aids in quality verification and customer identification.

attributes.name: application_summary
attributes.description: Summary of recommended applications and use cases for the chemical product. Guides customers on appropriate usage scenarios.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the technical authority who approved this TDS version for publication. Ensures technical accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this TDS version received final technical approval. Part of document control and audit trail.

attributes.name: boiling_point_unit
attributes.description: Temperature unit for boiling point measurement, either Celsius or Fahrenheit.

attributes.name: boiling_point_value
attributes.description: Temperature at which the product transitions from liquid to vapor phase at standard atmospheric pressure. Important for process design and safety.

attributes.name: compatibility_notes
attributes.description: Information on material compatibility and incompatibility with other chemicals, substrates, or container materials. Prevents adverse reactions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TDS record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: document_file_path
attributes.description: Internal file system or content management system path to the TDS document. Used for document retrieval and version control.

attributes.name: document_number

products.name: reach_dossier
products.description: REACH registration dossier record — the single source of truth (SSOT) for substance registration under EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, including the full Chemical Safety Report (CSR) and all exposure scenarios. Captures REACH registration number, substance identity (IUPAC name, CAS, EC number), registrant role (lead registrant, member), SIEF membership, tonnage band, registration date, dossier update date, ECHA submission reference, CSR requirement flag, and dossier status. Contains all exposure scenarios as child records: scenario title, use descriptor codes (SU, PC, PROC, AC, ERC), contributing scenario name, operational conditions (temperature, duration, frequency, amount used), risk management measures (PPE, ventilation, containment), DNEL values, PNEC values, risk characterization ratios (RCR), and scenario validity dates. Supports extended SDS (eSDS) generation for downstream users. Managed in Intelex EHS and submitted to ECHA REACH-IT. This entity is the sole owner of exposure scenario data — there is no separate exposure scenario entity.

products.name: delivery_line
products.description: This association product represents the physical execution of a sales order line item through an outbound delivery in chemical manufacturing. It captures the many-to-many relationship where a single outbound delivery can ship multiple order line items (consolidated shipment), and a single order line item can be split across multiple deliveries due to hazmat transport limits, tank capacity constraints, batch availability, or partial fulfillment. Each record links one outbound delivery to one line item with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific delivery execution: delivered quantity, batch numbers assigned, COA/COC attachment status per line, and temperature deviation tracking.. Existence Justification: In chemical manufacturing operations, the relationship between outbound deliveries and sales order line items is genuinely many-to-many. A single outbound delivery routinely consolidates multiple order line items from one or more sales orders into a single shipment (many line items to one delivery). Conversely, a single order line item is frequently split across multiple deliveries due to hazmat transport quantity limits, production batch availability, tank truck capacity constraints, or customer-requested partial fulfillment (one line item to many deliveries). This is the standard SAP SD/EWM delivery item concept.

products.name: plan_characteristic_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of a quality characteristic to an inspection plan in SAP QM. It captures the operational configuration that determines which characteristics must be inspected when a plan is executed, including sequence, mandatory status, and plan-specific overrides to the characteristic master definition. Each record links one inspection plan to one inspection characteristic with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment.. Existence Justification: In SAP QM and chemical manufacturing quality systems, inspection plans are reusable templates that define which characteristics must be measured, and characteristics are master definitions reused across multiple plans (e.g., 'Assay by HPLC' appears in every API product plan). The assignment of a characteristic to a plan is an operational configuration managed by quality engineers, carrying plan-specific data like sequence, mandatory flag, and overrides to the characteristic master definition.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Manages real-time stock positions for raw materials, intermediates, finished goods, and packaging materials across all warehouse locations and tank farms. Governs FIFO/FEFO lot rotation, hazardous material storage compliance, lot numbers, expiration dates, inventory movements, stock transfers, inventory valuation, and quarantine status. Integrates with SAP EWM and WMS for warehouse operations.

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Real-time stock position master record for each material (raw material, intermediate, finished good, packaging) at each storage location, bin, or tank farm. Tracks on-hand quantity, available quantity, reserved quantity, blocked quantity, unit of measure, batch/lot number, stock category, and stock type (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked, returns). Serves as the primary SSOT for current inventory levels across all SAP EWM-managed warehouses and tank farms. Supports FIFO/FEFO lot rotation logic and hazardous material storage compliance. Valuation carried as reference attribute for inventory reporting; authoritative valuation owned by finance domain.
products.reference: SAP EWM Stock Overview / MM Stock

attributes.description: Reference to the specific warehouse storage location, bin, or tank farm where the material is physically stored. Managed within SAP EWM warehouse structure.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material available for unrestricted use, calculated as on-hand quantity minus reserved, blocked, and quality inspection quantities. Drives ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks in SAP SD and production planning in SAP PP.

attributes.name: blocked_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material placed in blocked stock status due to quality failures, regulatory holds, damage, or quarantine. Blocked stock is not available for production or shipment until released by QA or EHS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Blocked Stock; GMP; OSHA; REACH

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stock position record was first created in the source system (SAP EWM). Provides audit trail for record lineage and supports SOX compliance for inventory record integrity.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Audit Trail; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material lot expires and is no longer suitable for use. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) lot rotation logic, regulatory compliance, and preventing use of out-of-specification materials. Sourced from SAP batch classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; REACH

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material was received into the warehouse via a goods receipt posting in SAP MM. Used as the FIFO reference date for lot rotation when manufacture date is unavailable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; ISO 9001

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material in this stock position is classified as a hazardous material requiring special storage, handling, and reporting under OSHA, DOT, EPA, and REACH regulations. Triggers hazmat storage compliance checks in EHS management.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; DOT 49 CFR; EPA TSCA; REACH; GHS

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material currently in transit between storage locations, plants, or external suppliers. Represents stock that has been shipped but not yet received at the destination, tracked via SAP EWM transfer orders.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Transfer Orders; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: last_count_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count was performed for this stock position. Used to assess inventory accuracy and schedule next count per SOX and ISO 9001 audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent inventory movement (goods issue, goods receipt, transfer order, or stock transfer) affecting this stock position. Used to identify slow-moving or obsolete inventory for write-off analysis.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Inventory Movement History; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: lot_rotation_method
attributes.description: The inventory rotation strategy applied to this stock position for picking and consumption sequencing. FIFO (First In First Out) is used for most materials; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is mandatory for materials with expiration dates per GMP requirements.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Lot Rotation; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; FEFO/FIFO Best Practice

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material lot was manufactured or produced. Used in conjunction with expiration_date to calculate shelf life and support FIFO/FEFO rotation. Sourced from SAP batch master or COA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Master; GMP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: maximum_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum allowable stock quantity for this material at this storage location, constrained by tank capacity, regulatory storage limits, or warehouse space. Enforced by SAP EWM capacity checks and EHS hazmat storage quantity limits under OSHA PSM.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Capacity Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM; EPA RMP

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Total physical quantity of the material currently present at the storage location, including all stock types (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked). Represents the gross inventory position before any reservations or holds are applied.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material currently under quality inspection in the LIMS or SAP QM module. This stock is not available for use until the inspection lot is closed and the material is released to unrestricted stock.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Inspection Lots; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001; GMP

attributes.name: quarantine_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason this stock position has been placed in quarantine or blocked status. Examples include failed QC test, regulatory hold, contamination suspicion, or pending CAPA investigation. Populated when stock_status is quarantine or stock_type is blocked.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; GMP; OSHA; CAPA Process; ISO 9001

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The minimum stock level at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this material at this storage location. Used by SAP MRP (Material Requirements Planning) to generate purchase requisitions or production orders automatically.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; ISO 9001 Inventory Control

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material reserved against open production orders, sales orders, or transfer orders in SAP. Reserved stock is committed but not yet physically moved, reducing the available quantity for new demand.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Reservations; SAP PP Production Orders

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum buffer stock quantity maintained to protect against supply disruptions, demand variability, or lead time uncertainty. Defined in SAP MRP parameters and used in available quantity calculations for production planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Safety Stock; ISO 9001

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this stock position record was captured or last refreshed from the source system (SAP EWM/S4HANA). Represents the as-of time for the inventory snapshot, critical for real-time inventory reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Real-Time Inventory; Databricks Silver Layer Data Freshness

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock position represents a special stock type such as consignment inventory, project stock, sales-order-specific stock, or vendor-managed inventory (VMI). Drives distinct accounting and ownership rules in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Special Stock; FASB ASC 330

attributes.name: stock_category
attributes.description: Classification of the material type held in this stock position. Drives inventory valuation rules, storage compliance requirements, and reporting segmentation across raw materials, intermediates, finished goods, and packaging materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Type; ISO 9001

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock position record. Quarantine status is applied when material is pending investigation or regulatory hold. Expired indicates the material has passed its expiration date. Recalled indicates a product recall event has been triggered.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Stock Status; GMP; OSHA PSM; REACH

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: SAP stock type classification indicating the usability state of the inventory. Unrestricted stock is available for use; quality_inspection stock is pending QC release; blocked stock is not available for use; returns stock is from customer returns; in_transit stock is between locations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Types; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical storage infrastructure type where the material is held. Drives hazardous material storage compliance rules under OSHA PSM, NFPA, and DOT regulations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk_tank|drum_rack|pallet_rack|cold_storage|hazmat_cage|silo|ibc_bay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP EWM Storage Type; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; NFPA 30; DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which all quantity fields for this stock position are expressed. Chemical manufacturing uses weight (KG, MT), volume (L, GAL, M3), and count (EA, DRUM, IBC) units depending on material type. Aligns with SAP MM base UOM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|TON|EA|BAG|DRUM|IBC|M3|FT3 — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stock position record was last modified in the source system. Used for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Audit Trail; SOX Section 404; Databricks CDC

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: SAP valuation class code that determines the general ledger (GL) accounts to which inventory postings are made for this material. Links inventory movements to the correct COGS and balance sheet accounts per FASB and SOX requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Valuation Class; FASB ASC 330; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: valuation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the valuation_price is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR). Required for multi-currency inventory valuation reporting across global plant locations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: Reference unit price used to calculate the inventory valuation of this stock position, expressed in the valuation currency. Carried as a reference attribute for inventory reporting; authoritative valuation is owned by the Finance domain (SAP FI/CO). May reflect standard cost or moving average price per SAP valuation class.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Material Valuation; FASB ASC 330 Inventory; SOX

attributes.name: warehouse_number
attributes.description: The SAP EWM warehouse number identifying the physical warehouse complex managing this stock position. Used for multi-warehouse inventory segregation and reporting.

products.name: warehouse_location

Captures location code, storage type, capacity (volume/weight), temperature range, humidity range, ventilation class, hazard class compatibility, NFPA fire diamond rating, incompatible hazard class segregation rules, maximum storage quantity per zone, fire zone, EPA/OSHA regulatory citations, and SAP EWM storage section mapping. Governs where specific chemical materials may be stored based on GHS/NFPA compatibility rules and required storage conditions.

attributes.name: area_sqm
attributes.description: Physical floor area of this storage location in square meters. Used for capacity planning, fire load calculations, and regulatory reporting of storage area dimensions per EPA and OSHA requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse location master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.

attributes.name: epa_regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Applicable EPA regulatory citation(s) governing storage requirements at this location (e.g., '40 CFR Part 264 - Hazardous Waste Storage', '40 CFR Part 68 - RMP'). Used for environmental compliance documentation, permit management, and regulatory audit support.

attributes.name: fire_zone_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the fire protection zone in which this storage location resides. Fire zones define the boundaries of fire suppression systems (sprinkler zones, deluge systems), fire detection circuits, and emergency evacuation areas. Referenced in PSM and HAZOP documentation.

attributes.name: floor_load_capacity_kg_m2

attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.22; NFPA 1; Building Structural Engineering Standards

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_class_compatibility
attributes.business_glossary_term: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Hazard Class Compatibility
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of GHS hazard classes that are approved for storage at this location (e.g., 'Flammable Liquid|Oxidizer|Corrosive'). Governs which chemical materials may be placed here based on GHS classification. Used to enforce chemical segregation rules and prevent incompatible co-storage.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev 9; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: height_m
attributes.description: Clear storage height in meters for this location. Used to determine maximum pallet stack height, forklift clearance requirements, and sprinkler system design (in-rack vs. ceiling sprinklers per NFPA 13).

attributes.name: incompatible_hazard_classes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incompatible GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Hazard Classes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of GHS hazard classes that must NOT be co-stored at this location due to chemical incompatibility or regulatory segregation requirements (e.g., 'Oxidizer|Explosive'). Enforces NFPA and OSHA chemical segregation rules to prevent dangerous reactions.

attributes.name: is_hazmat_approved
