attributes.name: consignment_stock_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consignment stock record. 'active' = vendor-owned stock available for consumption; 'consumed' = fully consumed and liability transferred; 'partially_consumed' = partially drawn down; 'returned' = returned to vendor; 'expired' = past expiration date; 'quarantine' = held pending quality disposition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Special Stock (MSKU); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: consignment_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the current consignment stock on hand, calculated as consignment_quantity multiplied by valuation_price. Used for balance sheet disclosure of vendor-owned stock, financial reporting, and off-balance-sheet liability tracking under FASB ASC 330 and SOX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Inventory Valuation; FASB ASC 330; SOX

attributes.name: consumed_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of consignment stock that has been consumed (goods-issued to production or other cost centers) and for which financial liability has been transferred to the manufacturer. Used for settlement reconciliation and VMI performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Consignment Goods Issue (MIGO 201K); MRKO Settlement

attributes.name: consumption_trigger
attributes.description: The agreed business event that triggers financial liability transfer from vendor to manufacturer for consignment stock. Defines when ownership and payable obligation are created. Aligned with SAP MM consignment settlement process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Consignment Settlement (MRKO); Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI) Agreement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the consignment stock record was first created in the system, typically upon goods receipt posting in SAP MM. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Document; SOX; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the valuation price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and foreign exchange revaluation under FASB and SOX.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; SOX

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the consignment material is no longer suitable for use per quality specifications or regulatory requirements. Drives FEFO lot rotation, quarantine triggers, and vendor return decisions. Critical for GMP and chemical stability compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Batch Management (MCH1); GMP; ISO 9001; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignment stock material is classified as hazardous under GHS, DOT, or OSHA regulations. Drives storage compliance requirements, SDS documentation obligations, and EHS reporting under TSCA and REACH.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); DOT 49 CFR; OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200); TSCA; REACH

attributes.name: last_consumption_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue (consumption) from this consignment stock lot. Used for slow-moving stock analysis, VMI replenishment planning, and consignment agreement compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Issue (MIGO); VMI Agreement

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the consignment stock record (e.g., quantity adjustment, status change, quarantine flag update). Supports data lineage, change audit, and Silver layer delta processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX; ISO 9001 Record Control; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: liability_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which financial ownership and payable liability for the consignment stock transferred from the vendor to the manufacturer, triggered by the agreed consumption event. Used for accounts payable accrual and financial period-end reporting under SOX and FASB ASC 330.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Accounts Payable; SOX Compliance; FASB ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: maximum_holding_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the consignment stock may be held at the manufacturer's premises per the consignment agreement before automatic return or forced consumption. Breach of this threshold may trigger penalty clauses or mandatory settlement.
attributes.references: Consignment Agreement Terms; SAP S/4HANA MM - Outline Agreement

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of consignment stock permitted at the manufacturer's premises per the VMI or consignment agreement. Prevents over-stocking of hazardous chemicals and ensures compliance with site storage limits under OSHA PSM and EPA RMP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP / VMI; OSHA PSM (29 CFR 1910.119); EPA RMP (40 CFR Part 68)

attributes.name: minimum_stock_level
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of consignment stock that must be maintained at the manufacturer's premises per the VMI agreement to ensure uninterrupted production supply. Triggers vendor replenishment when consignment_quantity falls below this threshold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP / VMI Replenishment; Consignment Agreement

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing site or facility where the consignment stock is physically located. Used for plant-level inventory reporting and regulatory site compliance.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number associated with the consignment stock receipt. For consignment arrangements, this is typically a consignment PO (order type KE or KB in SAP MM) that governs the replenishment and settlement terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchase Order (EKKO/EKPO); Consignment PO

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignment stock lot is currently placed under quality quarantine and restricted from consumption pending laboratory testing or quality disposition. Integrates with LabWare LIMS quality hold status and SAP QM usage decision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Usage Decision; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001; GMP

attributes.name: quarantine_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for placing the consignment stock under quarantine. OOS (Out of Specification), OOT (Out of Trend), vendor deviation, physical damage, contamination suspicion, pending COA (Certificate of Analysis), or regulatory hold. Supports CAPA initiation and quality investigation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oos_result|oot_result|vendor_deviation|damaged|contamination_suspect|pending_coa|regulatory_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001; GMP; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor-owned consignment stock was physically received and placed at the manufacturer's premises. Used for aging calculation, FIFO/FEFO rotation, and consignment agreement compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Receipt (MIGO); FIFO/FEFO Inventory Management

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the consignment lot must be retested by the quality laboratory to confirm continued conformance to specification before use. Common for chemical raw materials with defined shelf-life stability windows. Sourced from LabWare LIMS batch records.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS - Batch Retest; GMP; ISO 9001; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of consignment stock returned to the vendor without consumption, typically due to quality rejection, expiration, or excess inventory. Recorded as a consignment return movement in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Consignment Return (MIGO 122K); ISO 9001 CAPA

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the consignment material as specified in the SDS or vendor COA. Critical for flammable, reactive, or thermally unstable chemical feedstocks.
attributes.references: GHS SDS Section 7 (Handling and Storage); OSHA HazCom; NFPA; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the consignment material as specified in the SDS or vendor COA. Ensures compliant storage conditions for temperature-sensitive chemicals and prevents degradation or hazardous reactions.
attributes.references: GHS SDS Section 7 (Handling and Storage); OSHA HazCom; NFPA

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the consignment quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for litres, MT for metric tonnes, DRUM for drum containers). Aligned with SAP MM base UOM and chemical industry standard packaging units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|TON|M3|BAG|DRUM|IBC — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: Agreed unit price at which the consignment stock will be valued upon consumption and liability transfer. Used for inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and accounts payable settlement. Sourced from SAP MM purchasing info record or consignment agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI - Valuation (MBEW); FASB ASC 330 Inventory; SOX

Distinct from intra-warehouse transfer orders managed in SAP EWM.

attributes.description: Actual date on which the goods issue posting was made in SAP MM, confirming physical departure of material from the sending plant. Used for transit time analysis and on-time shipment KPI reporting.

attributes.name: actual_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the goods receipt posting was made in SAP MM at the receiving plant, confirming physical arrival and acceptance of the transferred material. Used for transit time calculation and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Official bill of lading document number issued for the shipment. Serves as the legal contract of carriage and is required for hazardous material transport documentation under DOT regulations and customs compliance.

attributes.name: carrier_name

attributes.name: carrier_reference_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned reference number (e.g., bill of lading number, waybill number, or pro number) for the shipment. Used to cross-reference with Oracle Transportation Management and carrier tracking systems.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created the stock transfer order in SAP S/4HANA. Required for audit trail, authorization control, and SOX compliance documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stock transfer order was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA). Represents the business event of order initiation, not the ETL load time.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: delivery_document_number

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator

attributes.name: intransit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently in transit between the sending and receiving plants — goods issued but not yet goods-receipted. Represents the stock-in-transit position used for real-time inventory visibility and financial valuation of in-transit inventory.

attributes.name: issued_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material physically issued (goods issued) from the sending plant's inventory at the time of transfer. May differ from transfer_quantity due to partial shipments or measurement variances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Goods Issue; SAP EWM

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the stock transfer order record in the source system. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: material_description

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material master number uniquely identifying the chemical, raw material, intermediate, finished good, or packaging material being transferred. Serves as the primary material reference across SAP MM, PP, and QM modules.

attributes.name: planned_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which goods are scheduled to be issued from the sending plant's inventory. Derived from the requested delivery date and transit lead time in SAP MM planning.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the stock transfer order, used to sequence fulfillment and logistics scheduling. Urgent transfers may be triggered by production line stoppages or critical inventory shortfalls.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number associated with this stock transfer order for cross-company or third-party warehouse transfers. Links the STO to the procurement document for financial settlement and accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: quarantine_status
attributes.description: Quality management status of the transferred material lot indicating whether it is available for unrestricted use or held under quarantine/quality hold pending inspection or testing. Integrates with SAP QM and LabWare LIMS quality disposition workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001; GMP; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material confirmed as received (goods received) at the destination plant. Used to calculate transfer variances, identify transit losses, and trigger inventory reconciliation. Populated upon goods receipt posting in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Goods Receipt; SAP EWM

attributes.name: receiving_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the destination plant, distribution center, or external warehouse that will receive the transferred material. Corresponds to the receiving plant in SAP MM stock transfer processing.

attributes.name: receiving_plant_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the destination plant or facility receiving the stock transfer. Provides human-readable context for reporting and operational dashboards without requiring a join to the plant master.

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location
attributes.description: SAP storage location code within the receiving plant where the material will be placed upon arrival. Identifies the target warehouse area, tank farm, or storage bin at the destination facility.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the transferred material is required to arrive at the receiving plant. Used for production planning, supply chain scheduling, and on-time delivery performance measurement.

attributes.name: sap_movement_type
attributes.description: SAP MM movement type code governing the inventory and accounting postings for this transfer (e.g., 641 for goods issue for STO, 101 for goods receipt). Determines the financial and inventory impact in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: sending_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the originating plant or manufacturing facility from which the material is being transferred. Corresponds to the issuing plant in SAP MM stock transfer processing.

attributes.name: sending_plant_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the originating plant or facility issuing the stock transfer. Provides human-readable context for reporting and operational dashboards without requiring a join to the plant master.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special stock type indicator identifying whether the transferred material is standard unrestricted stock or a special stock category such as consignment, project stock, or sales order stock. Affects inventory valuation and availability checking.

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Ordered quantity of material to be transferred from the sending plant to the receiving plant, expressed in the base unit of measure. Represents the planned transfer amount at order creation.

attributes.name: transfer_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for initiating the inter-plant stock transfer (e.g., production replenishment, inventory rebalancing, quality rework, customer order fulfillment). Used for operational analytics and cost allocation.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inter-plant stock transfer order. Tracks progression from creation through in-transit movement to receipt confirmation at the destination plant. attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inter-plant transfer indicating the nature of the movement (e.g., plant-to-plant, plant-to-distribution center, cross-company transfer). Determines the SAP movement type and accounting treatment in FI/CO.

attributes.name: transfer_value
attributes.description: Monetary value of the transferred material quantity based on the standard or moving average price at the sending plant. Used for inter-company or inter-plant inventory valuation and financial settlement in SAP FI/CO. Expressed in the company currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 330; SOX

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used to move the material between plants (e.g., road tanker, rail car, pipeline, barge). Relevant for hazardous material transport compliance under DOT 49 CFR and IATA/IMDG regulations for chemical shipments.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management; DOT 49 CFR; IMDG Code; NFPA

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: UN four-digit identification number assigned to hazardous materials for transport classification (e.g., UN1993 for flammable liquids). Required on shipping documents and placards for hazardous chemical transport under DOT 49 CFR and IMDG regulations.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; IMDG Code; GHS; OSHA

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the transfer quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, DRUM for drum containers). Aligns with SAP MM unit of measure configuration and chemical industry standard packaging units. domains.description: Commercial sales domain managing sales opportunities, quotes, contracts, pricing agreements, customer negotiations, sales pipeline, territory management, distributor channel data, and sales performance metrics. Supports technical sales with product application guidance and customer-specific formulations. Integrates with Salesforce CRM and SAP SD to drive revenue growth and customer acquisition.

products.name: opportunity
products.description: Core sales opportunity record tracking prospective deals with industrial chemical customers, distributors, and end-users. Captures opportunity stage progression, estimated deal value, probability of close, target close date, and owning sales representative. Includes opportunity-level product associations (per-product quantity, estimated revenue, competitive status) for pipeline visibility. Records structured win/loss outcome on closure (close reason, competitor displaced/displacing, decision criteria, deal value at close) for competitive intelligence. Sourced from Salesforce CRM. Primary pipeline management and forecasting entity for commercial sales.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sales opportunity record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (industrial buyer, distributor, or end-user) associated with this opportunity. Links to the customer/account master data product.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP SD Customer Master

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary customer contact person (e.g., procurement manager, technical buyer) associated with this opportunity. Links to the contact master data product.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Opportunities in chemical mfg are pursued by a specific legal entity — required for export control (TSCA/REACH jurisdiction), intercompany deal routing, and statutory revenue recognition reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Opportunities are tracked against profit centers for pipeline-to-revenue forecasting in chemical mfg financial planning. Finance uses this link to project expected revenue by profit center from the sa

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_specification. Business justification: Opportunity qualification requires checking the product's quality specification to ensure regulatory compliance and customer requirements.

attributes.name: reach_dossier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.reach_dossier. Business justification: REACH compliance is a legal prerequisite for selling chemicals in the EU market. When reach_compliance_required=true on an opportunity, the sales team must verify a valid REACH dossier exists. FK to r

attributes.name: regulatory_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.regulatory_profile. Business justification: Chemical sales opportunities must be validated against the customer's regulatory profile (REACH registration, TSCA applicability, export licenses). Linking opportunity to regulatory_profile enables co

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Chemical sales pipeline reporting by market segment (automotive, electronics, agriculture) is standard practice. opportunity.application_segment is a denormalized text field; replacing with segment_id

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Opportunity delivery planning uses the Customer Site to calculate logistics, compliance (REACH/SDS) and shipping terms.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory to which this opportunity is assigned. Supports territory-based pipeline reporting, quota management, and regional performance analytics.

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the opportunity was closed (won or lost). Populated upon opportunity closure. Used for sales cycle analysis, win/loss reporting, and period attribution. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Close Date; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: close_probability_pct
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0.00–100.00%) that this opportunity will be won, as assessed by the sales representative or derived from stage-based defaults. Used in weighted pipeline calculations and revenue forecasting models.

attributes.name: close_reason
attributes.description: Structured reason code explaining why the opportunity was won or lost. Captures the primary decision criterion at closure. Used for competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, and sales strategy refinement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Price|Technical Fit|Relationship|Competitor|Timeline|Budget|No Decision|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Win/Loss Reason; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: closed_amount
attributes.description: Actual deal value at the time of opportunity closure (won or lost). May differ from estimated_amount due to negotiation, scope changes, or competitive pricing adjustments. Used for win/loss revenue analysis and competitive intelligence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Amount; FASB ASC 606; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the opportunity record was first created in the source CRM system (Salesforce). Used for pipeline aging, sales cycle duration measurement, and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CreatedDate; SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Native opportunity identifier from Salesforce CRM (e.g., 006XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation with the source system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; SAP SD Integration

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated and closed deal amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency pipeline reporting and FX conversion in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: decision_criteria
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the customer's primary evaluation criteria for this opportunity (e.g., price, technical performance, regulatory compliance, delivery reliability, sustainability). Supports win/loss analysis and sales strategy development.

attributes.name: estimated_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total deal value (revenue) for this opportunity in the transaction currency. Represents the gross revenue expected if the opportunity is won. Used for pipeline valuation, quota tracking, and revenue forecasting. Aligns with SAP SD pricing and SAP FI/CO revenue planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Amount; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: estimated_volume_kg
attributes.description: Estimated annual or deal-period volume of chemical product(s) in kilograms associated with this opportunity. Used for supply chain capacity planning, raw material procurement forecasting, and production scheduling alignment with SAP PP.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quantity; SAP MM Material Planning

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter in which the opportunity is expected to close, formatted as Q[1-4]-YYYY (e.g., Q3-2024). Used for period-based pipeline reporting, quota attainment tracking, and financial forecasting aligned with SAP FI/CO fiscal calendar.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Fiscal Calendar; FASB ASC 606; SOX Quarterly Reporting

attributes.name: forecast_category
attributes.description: Sales forecast classification assigned to the opportunity, indicating the confidence level for revenue recognition in the current period. Used in executive revenue forecasting and financial planning aligned with SAP FI/CO reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Forecast Category; FASB Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: is_key_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opportunity is associated with a strategically designated key account (True) requiring executive sponsorship, dedicated account management, and priority resource allocation. Used for key account management reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Tier; ACC Responsible Care Customer Engagement

attributes.name: is_won
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the opportunity was closed as won (True) or lost/abandoned (False). Null if the opportunity is still open. Used for win rate calculations and pipeline conversion reporting.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sales activity (call, email, meeting, task) logged against this opportunity in Salesforce CRM. Used for pipeline hygiene monitoring, stale opportunity identification, and sales rep engagement tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the opportunity record was last updated in the source CRM system (Salesforce). Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate; SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: lead_source
attributes.description: Channel or origin through which this opportunity was identified or generated. Used for marketing attribution, channel effectiveness analysis, and sales pipeline sourcing analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Inbound|Trade Show|Referral|Cold Outreach|Distributor|Web|Other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: next_step
attributes.description: Free-text description of the immediate next action required to advance this opportunity (e.g., 'Schedule technical demo', 'Submit COA for customer qualification', 'Negotiate pricing terms'). Used by sales representatives for pipeline management and CRM activity tracking.

attributes.name: opportunity_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the opportunity context, customer requirements, technical application details, and strategic importance. Supports sales team knowledge sharing and opportunity review meetings.

attributes.name: opportunity_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the sales opportunity, typically describing the customer, product line, and deal context (e.g., 'Acme Corp - Specialty Solvents Q3 2024'). Used for pipeline reporting and sales team communication.

attributes.name: opportunity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the opportunity by business development type. Distinguishes new customer acquisition from expansion of existing accounts, contract renewals, win-back of lost customers, and channel type (distributor vs. direct). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: New Business|Existing Business Expansion|Renewal|Win-Back|Distributor|Direct — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Type; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The primary chemical product line or portfolio segment associated with this opportunity (e.g., Specialty Solvents, Performance Polymers, Agricultural Chemicals, Adhesives). Used for product-level pipeline and revenue mix reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Material Group; SAP MM Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: reach_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity involves chemical substances subject to REACH registration, evaluation, or authorization requirements under EU regulation. Triggers regulatory compliance review and ECHA documentation workflow.

attributes.name: requires_custom_formulation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opportunity requires a customer-specific chemical formulation or product development engagement (True) versus a standard catalogue product (False). Triggers R&D and technical sales involvement when True.
attributes.references: SAP SD Special Customer Requirements; R&D Project Initiation

attributes.name: requires_sds
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has requested or requires a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) / Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) as part of the sales process. Relevant for GHS compliance and REACH regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The commercial channel through which this opportunity is being pursued. Distinguishes direct sales from distributor-mediated, agent-based, e-commerce, or tender/bid processes. Used for channel performance analytics and margin analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SD Distribution Channel; Salesforce CRM Channel

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this opportunity record was sourced (e.g., Salesforce CRM, SAP SD, Manual entry). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; SAP SD Integration

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the opportunity in the sales pipeline lifecycle. Drives pipeline forecasting, stage-gate reviews, and funnel conversion analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Prospecting|Qualification|Needs Analysis|Proposal|Negotiation|Closed Won|Closed Lost — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Stage; ACC Responsible Care Sales Practices

attributes.name: target_close_date
attributes.description: Expected date by which the opportunity will be won or lost. Drives pipeline aging analysis, period-end forecasting, and sales cycle duration reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Close Date; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity involves chemical substances subject to TSCA inventory listing, reporting, or restriction requirements under US EPA regulation. Triggers regulatory compliance review.
attributes.references: TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act); EPA Chemical Data Reporting

products.name: quote
products.description: Formal price quotation issued to a customer or distributor for chemical products, including header-level terms (validity, incoterms, payment terms) and line-level detail (product/grade, quantity, UOM, per-line pricing, discounts, surcharges, COA/COC requirements). Supports RFQ response workflows and technical sales negotiations. Linked to SAP SD quotation and Salesforce CRM quote object. Enables granular margin analysis at the product-grade level.
products.reference: SAP SD Quotation / Salesforce CRM Quote

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the price quotation record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the quote entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or distributor to whom this quotation is issued. Links to the customer master record.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Chemical quotes are addressed to specific purchasing or technical contacts who have authority to accept pricing. Linking quote to contact enables proper document routing, COA/SDS delivery per contact

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master pricing agreement or sales contract under which this quotation is issued, linking spot quotes to long-term contractual frameworks.
attributes.references: SAP SD Outline Agreement; FASB ASC 606 Contract with Customer

attributes.name: legal_entity_id

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Quote generation attaches SDS, REACH, TSCA compliance data; linking to material_master provides authoritative source for those attributes.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Salesforce CRM sales opportunity from which this quotation was generated, enabling pipeline-to-revenue traceability and win/loss analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; ACC Responsible Care Commercial Practices

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD sales organization responsible for issuing this quotation, defining the legal selling entity and pricing hierarchy.

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.price_agreement. Business justification: While quote_line already carries a price_agreement_id at the line level, a quote header may be governed by a single overarching price agreement (e.g., a long-term supply agreement or contract price).

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Chemical mfg quotes are priced and margin-reported by profit center (e.g., Performance Materials vs. Ag Solutions). Revenue recognition and contribution margin reporting in CO-PA require knowing which

attributes.name: qualification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.qualification. Business justification: Chemical quotes must reference the customer qualification record confirming the product grade/spec is approved for that customer's use case. Quoting against an unqualified product-customer combination

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_specification. Business justification: Chemical quotes must reference the quality specification defining purity, grade, and acceptance criteria for the product being sold. This drives CoA/CoC issuance and ensures the customer receives exac

attributes.name: regulatory_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.regulatory_profile. Business justification: Chemical quotes require regulatory validation at generation time — export control flags, REACH compliance, and SDS version requirements are driven by the customer's regulatory profile. This link enabl

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sds. Business justification: Every chemical quote must reference the current SDS version for OSHA HazCom and REACH regulatory compliance. The sds_version plain-text field is denormalized; FK to sds ensures the correct SDS documen

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Quotes must reference the specific Customer Site for accurate pricing, tax, incoterms and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Analysis (COA) to accompany the chemical product shipment, confirming that the product meets specified quality parameters. Drives LabWare LIMS documentation workflow.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Records; LabWare LIMS COA Module; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: coc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Compliance (COC) confirming the product meets regulatory, contractual, or customer-specific specification requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Records; ACC Responsible Care Product Stewardship

attributes.name: converted_order_number
attributes.description: SAP SD sales order document number created when this quotation is accepted and converted to a binding sales order, enabling end-to-end quote-to-cash traceability.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order; FASB ASC 606 Performance Obligation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quotation record was first captured in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: crm_quote_number
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM quote object identifier, enabling bidirectional traceability between the CRM pipeline and the SAP SD quotation document.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values on this quotation are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: Customer's own Purchase Order (PO) reference number provided with the RFQ or acceptance, required for invoice matching and customer accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer PO Number; FASB ASC 606 Contract Identification

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code indicating the route to market for this quotation (e.g., direct, distributor, e-commerce), affecting pricing and availability determination.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: SAP SD division code representing the product line or business unit (e.g., Performance Materials, Agricultural Solutions, Plastics) responsible for this quotation.

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any product in this quotation is subject to export control regulations, triggering mandatory compliance review before order conversion (e.g., EAR, ITAR, dual-use chemical controls).
attributes.references: TSCA Export Notification Requirements; DOT 49 CFR; EAR 15 CFR 730-774

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross value of the quotation before application of discounts, surcharges, and taxes, expressed in the quotation currency. Supports margin analysis and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Procedure; FASB ASC 606 Transaction Price

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quoted products are classified as hazardous materials under DOT, IATA, or IMDG regulations, requiring special packaging, labeling, and transport documentation.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA DGR; GHS Classification; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost allocation between seller and buyer for chemical product shipments.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; DOT Hazardous Materials Transport Regulations; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port associated with the Incoterms code, specifying the exact point of delivery or risk transfer (e.g., 'FOB Houston Port'). Required for complete Incoterms specification per ICC rules.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Incoterms Location

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this quotation record, supporting change tracking and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net total value of the quotation after all discounts and surcharges but before tax, representing the agreed commercial value. Core metric for margin analysis at the quote level.
attributes.references: SAP SD Net Value; FASB ASC 606 Transaction Price

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP SD payment terms key defining the agreed payment schedule, early payment discount conditions, and due date calculation for the customer invoice (e.g., NT30, 2/10NET30).
attributes.references: SAP SD Payment Terms; FASB ASC 606 Significant Financing Component

attributes.name: price_list_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing basis applied to this quotation, determining which SAP SD condition records and pricing procedures are used for calculation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Price List; ACC Responsible Care Pricing

attributes.name: pricing_date
attributes.description: The reference date used to determine applicable price lists, condition records, and raw material index values for pricing calculation. May differ from quote_date for forward-priced contracts.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Date; FASB ASC 606 Contract Modification

attributes.name: quote_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the quotation was formally issued to the customer or distributor. Represents the principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quotation Creation Date; FASB Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: quote_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the quotation, tracking progression from initial draft through customer acceptance or expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|expired|converted|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Status; Salesforce CRM Quote Stage

attributes.name: quote_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quotation by commercial purpose: standard customer quote, spot market offer, contract pricing, distributor channel, intercompany transfer, or product sample. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|spot|contract|distributor|intercompany|sample — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Type; ACC Responsible Care Commercial Practices

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all chemical substances in this quotation are registered and compliant under REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 for the destination market, required for EU export.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; ECHA Guidance on Registration

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for quotation rejection or loss, populated when quote_status transitions to rejected or cancelled. Supports win/loss analysis and competitive intelligence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_too_high|competitor_selected|spec_mismatch|delivery_terms|no_decision|budget_cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Rejection Reason; Salesforce CRM Close Lost Reason

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested delivery date for the quoted chemical products, used for production scheduling, ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks, and logistics planning.
attributes.references: SAP SD Requested Delivery Date; SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: sales_district_code
attributes.description: SAP SD sales district code identifying the geographic territory assignment for this quotation, used for territory management, sales performance reporting, and commission calculation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales District; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: sap_quotation_number
attributes.description: The externally-known 10-digit SAP SD quotation document number used for cross-system reference and customer-facing communication.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Type QT

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for chemical product delivery. Drives export control screening, REACH compliance checks, and hazardous material transport regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; TSCA Export Notification

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the quotation, including VAT, GST, or applicable excise duties on chemical products, calculated per the customer's tax jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP SD Tax Condition; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; EPA Excise Tax Regulations

attributes.name: technical_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing technical sales notes, application guidance, customer-specific formulation requirements, or special handling instructions relevant to the quoted chemical products.
attributes.references: SAP SD Header Text; ACC Responsible Care Product Stewardship

attributes.name: total_discount_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate monetary discount applied across all line items on the quotation, including volume rebates, customer-specific pricing adjustments, and promotional discounts.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Type RA00; FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: total_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate surcharges applied at the header level, including energy surcharges, raw material index surcharges, hazardous material handling fees, and freight surcharges.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Type ZSU1; ACC Responsible Care Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The start date from which the quoted prices, terms, and conditions are binding and may be accepted by the customer.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quotation Validity Start; FASB ASC 606 Contract Identification

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The expiry date after which the quoted prices and terms are no longer binding. Drives automated expiry workflows and renewal alerts.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quotation Validity End; FASB ASC 606 Contract Identification

attributes.name: win_probability_pct
attributes.description: Sales representative's estimated probability (0.00–100.00%) that this quotation will be accepted and converted to a sales order, used for pipeline forecasting and revenue planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Probability; ACC Responsible Care Sales Forecasting

products.name: quote_line
products.description: Individual line item within a customer quote, representing a specific chemical product, grade, or SKU with its own pricing, quantity, unit of measure (kg, MT, L, drums), and technical specification reference. Captures per-line discount, surcharges (e.g., hazmat handling, small-order), and COA/COC requirements. Enables granular margin analysis at the product-grade level.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual line item within a customer quote. Primary key for the quote_line entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.references: SAP MM - Material Master (MATNR); SAP SD - Sales Order Item

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or distribution center designated to fulfill this quote line. Determines production scheduling, inventory sourcing, and applicable plant-level pricing.
attributes.references: SAP MM/PP - Plant (WERKS); SAP SD - Delivering Plant

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue posting requires each quote line to map to a GL account for accurate financial reporting and downstream invoicing.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grade. Business justification: Chemical grade (USP, ACS, technical) is a primary commercial differentiator on quote lines, driving price tier, regulatory compliance requirements, and COA/COC obligations. The product_grade plain-tex

attributes.name: lot_id

attributes.name: packaging_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_config. Business justification: Packaging configuration drives hazmat surcharges, UN certification requirements, and freight cost on chemical quote lines. The packaging_type plain-text field is denormalized; FK to packaging_config e

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer-specific pricing agreement, contract price list, or framework agreement that governs the unit price on this quote line. Links to long-term supply agreements and volume rebate contracts.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Pricing Condition Record (VK11); Salesforce CRM - Price Book

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Quote lines in chemical mfg are assigned to profit centers for contribution margin reporting by business segment. CO-PA reporting requires line-level profit center assignment to analyze margin by prod

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_specification. Business justification: Each quote line references a specific chemical product at a defined grade/spec. attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: revision_reason

attributes.description: Sequential version number of the distributor agreement, incremented each time the agreement is formally amended (e.g., price renegotiation, territory expansion, MOQ revision). Version 1 is the original executed agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Amendment; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal amendment to this distributor agreement. Null if no amendments have been made since original execution. Used with agreement_version for change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: amendment_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the most recent amendment to this distributor agreement, summarizing the key changes made (e.g., 'Territory expanded to include CAN; MOQ increased to USD 500,000'). Supports audit trail and Management of Change (MOC) documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ISO 9001 Document Control; SOX

attributes.name: authorized_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Chemical Mfg product category codes or names that the distributor is authorized to sell under this agreement (e.g., 'Performance Coatings, Agricultural Chemicals, Specialty Polymers'). Governs which SKUs can be ordered against this agreement in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Material Group; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distributor agreement automatically renews upon expiry unless either party provides written notice of termination within the notice period. Drives renewal workflow automation in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must accompany each product shipment to the distributor under this agreement, confirming that the batch meets specification. Supports GMP and ISO 9001 quality documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distributor agreement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Populated at insert time and never updated. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 9001 Record Control; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable credit extended to the distributor under this agreement, denominated in USD. Enforced in SAP SD credit management (FD32) to control financial exposure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Credit Management (FD32); FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all financial terms of this agreement (MOQ, rebates, pricing) are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency reporting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Currency Configuration; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving disputes arising under this distributor agreement: arbitration (binding third-party arbitration), litigation (court proceedings), mediation (non-binding third-party mediation), or negotiation (direct party negotiation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Terms; SOX

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the distributor agreement becomes legally binding and commercially operative. Aligns with SAP SD contract validity start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Validity Start; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: ehs_training_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Training Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether distributor personnel are required to complete Chemical Mfg-mandated EHS (Environment Health and Safety) training on product handling, storage, and emergency response as a condition of this agreement.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; Intelex EHS Management; ISO 45001

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of exclusivity granted to the distributor within the authorized territory: full_portfolio (all Chemical Mfg products), product_category (specific product categories only), single_product (one product or SKU), or none (non-exclusive arrangement).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Terms; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the distributor agreement naturally expires. Nullable for open-ended evergreen agreements. Used to trigger renewal workflows and compliance reviews.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Validity End; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of this distributor agreement (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR). Critical for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; SOX; REACH (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between Chemical Mfg and the distributor for shipments under this agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD — Incoterms; DOT Hazardous Materials Transport

attributes.name: moq_annual_usd
attributes.description: Minimum annual purchase commitment in US dollars that the distributor must achieve to maintain agreement terms and qualify for contracted pricing and rebates. Failure to meet MOQ may trigger agreement renegotiation or termination. Aligns with SAP SD minimum order value configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Minimum Order Value; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP SD payment terms key (e.g., 'NT30', 'NT60', '2/10NT30') governing invoice due dates and early payment discount conditions for orders placed under this agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Payment Terms (ZTERM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: product_application_support
attributes.description: Indicates whether Chemical Mfg provides technical sales and product application guidance support to the distributor under this agreement, including customer-specific formulation assistance and technical documentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Technical Sales; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: reach_downstream_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor must fulfill REACH downstream user reporting obligations, including use notifications and exposure scenario communication, as required under ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Title V.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 — Title V Downstream Users; ECHA Guidance on Downstream Users

attributes.name: rebate_rate_pct
attributes.description: Base rebate percentage (0.00–100.00) applied to eligible purchases under this agreement. For volume_tiered structures, this represents the base tier rate; tier thresholds are managed in the rebate schedule. Stored in SAP SD rebate agreement condition records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Rebate Condition Rate; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: rebate_structure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate mechanism applicable to this distributor agreement: volume_tiered (rebate percentage increases with purchase volume tiers), flat_rate (fixed percentage on all purchases), growth_incentive (rebate tied to year-over-year growth targets), or none (no rebate applicable).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Rebate Agreement (BO); FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date by which a renewal decision must be made or the agreement auto-renews. Drives CRM (Salesforce) renewal opportunity creation and account manager notifications.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to expiry_date by which either party must provide written notice of non-renewal or termination. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days as negotiated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: responsible_care_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor is contractually required to adhere to the ACC (American Chemistry Council) Responsible Care program standards as a condition of this distribution agreement.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care Program; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: sap_contract_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD contract document number (transaction VA41/VA42) corresponding to this distributor agreement. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the CRM pipeline and ERP order management.

attributes.name: sds_distribution_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor is contractually obligated to distribute Safety Data Sheets (SDS) to downstream customers for all chemical products sold under this agreement. Mandatory under GHS, REACH, and OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200).
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200); ECHA REACH Article 31

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which both parties executed (signed) the distributor agreement. May differ from effective_date when agreements are backdated or post-dated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the agreement was terminated early (before natural expiry). Null if the agreement has not been terminated. Distinct from expiry_date which represents the scheduled end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Status; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for early termination of the distributor agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mutual_agreement|breach_of_contract|moq_failure|compliance_violation|business_exit|acquisition|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Intelex EHS Management (compliance_violation); ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: territory_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the primary country of the authorized distribution territory. Used for REACH downstream user reporting and EPA/TSCA jurisdictional compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope within which the distributor is authorized to sell Chemical Mfg products under this agreement. May be expressed as country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), regions, or named sales territories (e.g., 'USA,CAN,MEX' or 'EMEA-West'). Supports territory management analytics in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; REACH Downstream User Reporting (ECHA)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this distributor agreement record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every modification. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Databricks Delta Lake CDC; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

products.name: rebate_agreement
products.description: Volume-based or performance-based rebate agreement with a customer or distributor, defining rebate tiers, calculation basis (revenue or volume), accrual method, settlement frequency, and eligible product scope. Captures rebate type (volume rebate, growth incentive, market development fund), threshold levels, and payout currency. Maps to SAP SD rebate processing (BO01/BO02). Distinct from price_agreement — rebates are retrospective settlements, not upfront pricing.

attributes.name: rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sales rebate agreement record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or distributor party with whom this rebate agreement is established. Links to the customer master.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: accrual_gl_account_id
